how: Describe the task, the audience, sample inputs, and failure modes you have seen; ask for a prompt with explicit output format and edge-case handling; then A/B it against your current version.
name: Meta Prompting
what: Using a model to write, critique, or refine prompts, describing the task and letting the model draft the instructions another run will follow.
when_fails: Blind trust: a model-written prompt inherits the model's guesses about your intent, and it can be verbose. The output is a draft to test against real cases, not a finished artifact.
when_works: Bootstrapping good prompts fast, tightening prompts that drift, and generating variations to test. Vendor tools (prompt improvers and generators) productize exactly this.
